# DomainControl
> DomainControl provides domain registration, DNS management, web hosting, email, and website tools through GoDaddy's customer control panel.

DomainControl is the account and product management interface used by GoDaddy customers to manage domains, DNS records, websites, hosting, email, billing, and account settings.

## Domain Management
- [Domain Control Center](https://domaincontrol.com/): Main dashboard for managing registered domains and connected products.
- [Domain Portfolio](https://dcc.godaddy.com/): Central interface for viewing and managing domain holdings.
- [DNS Management](https://dcc.godaddy.com/manage/dns): Manage DNS zones, records, nameservers, and forwarding settings.
- [Domain Forwarding](https://dcc.godaddy.com/manage/dns): Configure domain and subdomain forwarding from DNS settings.
- [Nameserver Settings](https://dcc.godaddy.com/manage/dns): Update default, custom, or delegated nameservers for domains.
- [Domain Privacy and Protection](https://dcc.godaddy.com/): Access domain protection and ownership-related controls.
- [Domain Transfers](https://dcc.godaddy.com/): Manage transfer locks, authorization codes, and transfer status.

## DNS and Connectivity
- [DNS Zone Editor](https://dcc.godaddy.com/manage/dns): Add, edit, and remove A, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, and AAAA records.
- [DNS Templates](https://dcc.godaddy.com/manage/dns): Apply common DNS configurations for websites, email, and verification.
- [Nameserver Management](https://dcc.godaddy.com/manage/dns): Switch between GoDaddy nameservers and custom DNS providers.
- [Domain Connect](https://domainconnect.godaddy.com/): Standardized DNS configuration service for third-party integrations.
- [Domain Connect API](https://domainconnect.godaddy.com/docs): Technical documentation for automated DNS setup using Domain Connect.
- [SSL and Verification Records](https://dcc.godaddy.com/manage/dns): Configure TXT and CNAME records for certificates and service validation.

## Help and Support
- [GoDaddy Help Center](https://www.godaddy.com/help): Central support hub for products, billing, and account management.
- [Manage DNS Records](https://www.godaddy.com/help/manage-dns-records-680): Help article for editing and maintaining DNS entries.
- [Add an A Record](https://www.godaddy.com/help/add-an-a-record-19238): Instructions for pointing a domain to an IPv4 address.
- [Add a CNAME Record](https://www.godaddy.com/help/add-a-cname-record-19236): Guide to aliasing subdomains to another hostname.
- [Add an MX Record](https://www.godaddy.com/help/add-an-mx-record-19237): Steps for routing email through a mail provider.
- [Change Nameservers](https://www.godaddy.com/help/change-nameservers-for-my-domains-664): Instructions for updating domain nameserver settings.
- [Forward My GoDaddy Domain](https://www.godaddy.com/help/forward-my-godaddy-domain-12123): Guide to setting up domain forwarding and masking.

## Account and Security
- [Sign In](https://sso.godaddy.com/): Secure sign-in for GoDaddy and DomainControl account access.
- [My Products](https://account.godaddy.com/products): View and manage domains, hosting, email, and other purchased products.
- [Account Settings](https://account.godaddy.com/settings): Manage profile details, preferences, and account configuration.
- [Login and PIN](https://account.godaddy.com/security): Update password, verification methods, and account security settings.
- [Payment Methods](https://account.godaddy.com/billing/payment-methods): Manage saved cards and billing preferences.
- [Order History](https://account.godaddy.com/orders): Review purchases, renewals, and transaction history.

## Developer and API
- [GoDaddy Developer Portal](https://developer.godaddy.com/): Entry point for APIs, keys, documentation, and developer resources.
- [Domains API Overview](https://developer.godaddy.com/doc/endpoint/domains): Reference for domain availability, registration, and management endpoints.
- [Domains API Documentation](https://developer.godaddy.com/doc): API docs for domains, DNS, certificates, and related services.
- [Production Access](https://developer.godaddy.com/keys): Create and manage API keys for GoDaddy developer services.
- [Developer Guides](https://developer.godaddy.com/doc/endpoint/domains#/v1): Explore endpoint-specific details and request formats.
- [Domain Connect GitHub Organization](https://github.com/Domain-Connect): Open-source resources and specifications for Domain Connect integrations.

## Email and Productivity
- [Professional Email](https://account.godaddy.com/products): Access and manage email-related subscriptions from product dashboard.
- [Microsoft 365 Management](https://account.godaddy.com/products): Manage Microsoft 365 email and productivity services.
- [Email DNS Setup](https://dcc.godaddy.com/manage/dns): Configure MX, SPF, DKIM, and verification records for email delivery.
- [Workspace and Mail Help](https://www.godaddy.com/help/email): Support resources for email setup, migration, and troubleshooting.

## Hosting and Websites
- [Web Hosting Products](https://account.godaddy.com/products): Manage hosting plans, websites, and connected services.
- [Website Security and SSL](https://account.godaddy.com/products): Access SSL certificates and website protection products.
- [Managed WordPress](https://account.godaddy.com/products): Manage WordPress hosting environments and settings.
- [Website Builder](https://account.godaddy.com/products): Access website creation and editing tools tied to your account.
- [Connect Domain to Hosting](https://dcc.godaddy.com/manage/dns): Point domains to hosting using DNS records or nameserver changes.

## Billing and Renewals
- [Renewals and Billing](https://account.godaddy.com/billing): Manage renewals, billing settings, and subscription charges.
- [Auto-Renew Settings](https://account.godaddy.com/products): Enable or disable automatic renewal for eligible products.
- [Invoices and Receipts](https://account.godaddy.com/orders): Access order confirmations and billing history.
- [Payment Options](https://account.godaddy.com/billing/payment-methods): Update payment instruments used for renewals and purchases.

## Additional Resources

- [WHOIS Search](https://www.godaddy.com/whois): Look up domain registration data and ownership-related information.
